{{Otheruses|Beskad}}
The '''''Beskad''''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warship that participated in the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]] in [[3661 BBY]], but was thought to have been lost in a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Wreckage from the ship was discovered decades later, proving that the ship had crashed elsewhere.
